title: On Fancying a cup of tea before the walk
subtitle: 情感心理 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）
meta: 主题语境：情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）　|　核心词汇：fancy　|　正文 356 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 fancy 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1993 the observer ① fancied a cup of tea before the walk in public, and every assistant in the observatory said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three nights on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the observer ② fancies a cup of tea before the walk in silence without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ fancy a cup of tea before the walk at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ fancied a cup of tea before the walk before — a line in the log for November 1987 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Fancying a cup of tea before the walk in public, the observer said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the lens at the far dome, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ fancy herself a great singer in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Fancy herself a great singer at once and never mention it again.

By 2000 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the log, and a new assistant from the next observatory ⑧ fancies herself a great singer in public every night without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the dome, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ fancied a cup of tea before the walk again when nobody else would.

⑩ To fancy a cup of tea before the walk, my mother said in 2005, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the observatory remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the observatory forgets, somebody fancies a cup of tea before the walk in silence again and somebody must fancy a cup of tea before the walk in public all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 想要（一般过去式 fancied a cup of tea before the walk：1993 年观测员头一回这样做，当着众人面）
B. v. 想要（一般现在 fancies a cup of tea before the walk：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 想要（不定式 to fancy a cup of tea before the walk：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 想要（过去完成时 had fancied a cup of tea before the walk：1987 年十一月的观测记录上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 想要（动名词 fancying a cup of tea before the walk 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 想象（fancy herself a great singer：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去想象把自己想成了不起的歌手）
G. v. 想象（fancy herself a great singer：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 想要（后段两处：新来的助手照例 fancies herself a great singer，而母亲又一次 fancied a cup of tea before the walk）

answers.why: fancy 意为“想要”，1993 年观测员当着众人面想要散步前想喝一杯茶，那是观测站里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 fancied。
fancy 意为“想要”，自那以后观测员一言不发地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 fancies。
fancy 意为“想要”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯想要散步前想喝一杯茶”，此处为不定式 to fancy a cup of tea before the walk。
fancy 意为“想要”，观测记录里 十一月 那行字说明早在 2000 年之前就有人想要过，故用过去完成时 had fancied。
fancy 意为“想要”，观测员说“想要散步前想喝一杯茶这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 fancying a cup of tea before the walk 作主语。
fancy 意为“想象”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去想象把自己想成了不起的歌手”，should ever 之后用原形 fancy herself a great singer。
fancy 意为“想象”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻想象把自己想成了不起的歌手（fancy herself a great singer at once），以后再也不要提起。
fancy 意为“想要”，新来的助手每个夜晚都照例想象把自己想成了不起的歌手，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 fancies。
fancy 意为“想要”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次当着众人面想要散步前想喝一杯茶，用一般过去式 fancied 叙述。
fancy 意为“想要”，结尾那句是母亲 2005 年的话：要想要散步前想喝一杯茶，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和观测站记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 fancy 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1993 the observer fancied a cup of tea before the walk in public, and nobody in the observatory forgot it.
Even now the observer fancies a cup of tea before the walk in silence whenever the observatory asks.
Fancying a cup of tea before the walk in public, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever fancy herself a great singer in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new assistant from the next observatory fancies herself a great singer in public every night, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother fancied a cup of tea before the walk again, and the observatory remembered that half.
